identity.title: Controlled Hermes Research Runtime Core
identity.objective: Add a dormant-by-default, deterministic control plane around one bounded, one-shot, web-only EXTERNAL Hermes research session: a validated content-addressed request drives a frozen non-broadenable invocation policy and compact envelope, an argv-only ephemeral-cwd backend (fake in tests) runs the pinned v0.21.3 one-shot and produces a bounded plain-stdout response plus a usage-file report, and the repository authoritatively validates the untrusted research draft schema and safety before emitting a sanitized no-authority receipt requiring human review, while creating no opportunity candidate, probability thesis, strategy, paper/execution/live/credential/scheduler authority, or dependency/workflow change.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: The user transmitted and instructed execution of the WP175H one-shot runtime package, whose natural authorized envelope is 16-22 paths with a hard maximum of 24. The exact truthful scope is 24 files: 15 new (package spec/prompt/status/contract, six runtime modules, and four focused tests plus the new test-package __init__ required so pytest prepend-mode import does not collide the runtime test_models basename with the existing executable_edge test_models) and nine additive registrations (docs, the architecture-boundary and two doc-guard tests, and the two WP149-era Hermes-no-runtime guards that legitimately must allowlist the new runtime package). 24 exceeds the L budget of 20, so the package is XL for scope size only with a hard maximum of 24 files and no broadened authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175H. Only the additive dormant controlled Hermes research runtime package (models, policy, response/usage-file parser, runner backends, controller), its four focused test files, the new canonical runtime contract, the WP175H status/spec/prompt, and the scoped docs/repo-truth/deferred/roadmap and doc-guard/architecture-boundary registrations are removed. No dependency, workflow, credential, account, order, paper, Gate-C, WP176, or live state exists to unwind, and no other module changes behavior.

api_matrix.reason: WP175H introduces the first repo-owned control plane for a real external Hermes research session as a dormant, provider-neutral runtime primitive with no downstream authority.

items.before: No repo-owned Hermes runtime request type
items.after: Immutable content-addressed HermesResearchRunRequest with fail-closed field/bound/secret/authority validation
items.compatibility_requirement: No credential, environment, wallet, order, or execution field is accepted or echoed

items.after: Frozen non-broadenable policy pinned to Hermes v0.21.3 with exactly the web toolset and an argv-only one-shot command shape
items.compatibility_requirement: No caller may broaden toolsets or enable shell/repo-mount/mcp/plugin/cron/delegation/file/terminal/code-execution

items.after: One protocol with a deterministic no-process fake and an isolated argv-only ephemeral-cwd external backend with byte caps, timeout, tree-kill, and teardown
items.compatibility_requirement: Tests and CI use the fake/local backend and make zero paid/provider calls; no credential is read, injected, or logged

items.after: Bounded plain-stdout response capture plus bounded usage-file parse plus authoritative untrusted-draft schema/safety validation emitting a sanitized no-authority HermesResearchRunReceipt
items.compatibility_requirement: Hermes output is untrusted; the repo validator is authoritative; fail-closed with no raw payload/stderr/env/secret in canonical evidence

semantic_fields.reason: Request/policy/draft/receipt identities and admissibility, tool isolation, budget, and no-authority fields have explicit fail-closed semantics.

items.required_rule: hermesresearchrequest:sha256 over canonical public request fields; unknown fields, secrets, and authority-escalation content are rejected
items.validation_rule: recompute and exact compare; path excluded

items.required_rule: canonical Decimal from string/int within the repository absolute maximum; binary floats are rejected as non-canonical; this is a POST-RUN acceptance threshold, not a pre-spend hard stop
items.validation_rule: reject binary float and any value above the absolute maximum

items.required_rule: UNAVAILABLE_ON_PINNED_V0_21_3_ONESHOT; --max-turns is chat-subparser only and the tagged -z path sets no max_iterations, so no iteration cap exists or is claimed and no max_turns field/flag is carried
items.validation_rule: policy construction fails closed on any other value

items.required_rule: exactly 0 for the first controlled runtime; zero automatic paid research retries because a paid call can spend before a timeout/transport failure
items.validation_rule: policy construction fails closed above the absolute ceiling of 0

items.required_rule: process exit code is authoritative; only exit_code == 0 may proceed toward success and any other code fails closed with no retry even when stdout is syntactically valid
items.validation_rule: nonzero exit is a terminal EXIT_CODE_NONZERO failure

items.required_rule: a valid usage report is mandatory success evidence; completed exactly true, failed exactly false, and valid non-negative input/output/total token and api_call integers plus present model/provider/session_id; a missing/malformed/incomplete usage report is USAGE_EVIDENCE_INVALID and never inferred from stdout
items.validation_rule: success requires usage_evidence_status VALID; otherwise fail closed with no retry

items.required_rule: success binds the VERIFIED actual usage provider/model and requires usage.provider == request.provider_label and usage.model == request.model_label; a mismatch is PROVIDER_MODEL_MISMATCH and fails closed with no retry
items.validation_rule: verified provider/model equal the frozen request on success; None on non-success

items.required_rule: POST-RUN cost acceptance reads the exact tagged cost_status vocabulary (actual/estimated/included/unknown); a missing/invalid estimated_cost_usd or a missing/unknown/out-of-vocabulary cost_status is COST_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE and a missing cost is never treated as zero
items.validation_rule: success requires a known finite in-threshold cost; unknown cost fails closed

items.required_rule: exactly the single web toolset; no caller may broaden it or enable forbidden tool families
items.validation_rule: policy construction fails closed on any broadening

items.required_rule: EPHEMERAL_EMPTY_DIRECTORY; the external backend never supplies the repository, local_data, or home path as the Hermes working directory
items.validation_rule: ephemeral mkdtemp cwd only; repo/home/local_data rejected

items.required_rule: every advisory/no-execution/no-risk/no-credential/no-order/no-paper-live/no-promotion/no-merge flag must be present and exactly true or the untrusted draft is rejected
items.validation_rule: repo validator authoritative; missing or false flag fails closed; no retry

items.required_rule: non-empty bounded https citations with title and closed source_class; empty or fabricated non-url citations fail closed
items.validation_rule: sanitized to url digest plus source class in canonical evidence

items.required_rule: hermesresearchreceipt:sha256 over sanitized receipt content; a deterministic successful transcript yields an exact receipt id
items.validation_rule: recompute and exact compare; path excluded

items.required_rule: CODE_COMPLETE_NOT_REMOTE_ACTIVATED unless a separately gated real run is explicitly performed; runtime activation is never implied by code-complete
items.validation_rule: default is code-complete; run-complete is explicit only

identity_derivations.reason: Product identity recomputation and one-field tamper behavior are executable focused-test oracles; no worked package-spec oracle is required.

state_transitions.reason: RUNTIME deterministic readiness supplies draftability and the user's authorization supplies implementation authority; neither grants merge or runtime activation.

items.condition: prompt/spec authority equality, exact scope, semantics, evidence plan, and deterministic RUNTIME readiness pass without a certificate
the user explicitly authorizes implementation of this exact WP175H branch/worktree/package
implementation stays inside the exact 24-file scope and final readiness --check-diff passes with zero real provider calls

examples.reason: Focused executable tests are the product oracle and no package-spec identity derivation requires an embedded worked example.

evidence_plan.reason: R001-R024 cover the reviewer-trap matrix, pinned Hermes contract, tool/filesystem/credential isolation, bounded subprocess/timeout/teardown, transport-retry ceiling, plain-stdout/usage-file parsing, deterministic output schema, no-authority validation, source provenance, budget, receipt identity, legacy compatibility, and the code-complete vs runtime-activated split.

items.expected_result: a version preflight reporting a version other than 0.21.3 yields a VERSION_MISMATCH receipt with no research invocation
shell metacharacters in the executable path are rejected and metacharacter arguments reach the child literally with no shell side effect
the child working directory is an ephemeral temp dir that is never the repository, home, or a local_data path, is deleted on teardown, and its usage file is read back
the controller argv includes exactly one permitted web toolset, no broader toolset, and no unsupported --input-file or --format stream-json flag
enabling terminal/file/browser/delegation/memory/cron/mcp/plugin or a second retry fails policy construction closed
an unknown request field is rejected with REQUEST_UNKNOWN_FIELD
secret-looking request content is rejected and never echoed in the sanitized error
a malformed usage report fails closed with a neutral diagnostic and no raw payload echo
oversized stdout fails boundedly with RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE
a timed-out invocation produces a sanitized TIMEOUT receipt with the timeout budget status
at most one transport retry occurs; a second retry never happens
a schema-validation failure is not retried and the backend is invoked exactly once
unsafe trading-authority draft content is a safety failure that is not retried
an empty or fabricated non-url citation structure fails the source-provenance check
no raw stderr, environment dump, usage payload, or secret can enter the sanitized receipt
the fake backend performs zero process and zero network calls even when Popen is patched to fail
identical request bytes yield an identical request id and any field change alters it
a deterministic successful fake transcript yields an exact receipt id
legacy WP133 and WP99 focused advisory validator tests remain green and unchanged
the runtime package imports no execution_gateway, paper_trading, oms, risk, or private-account/network surface
the default activation state is CODE_COMPLETE_NOT_REMOTE_ACTIVATED and runtime-complete is explicit only
no Alpha Factory candidate, probability, expected-return, side, or trade object is created or surfaced

items.expected_result: deterministic RUNTIME readiness and an exact 24-file diff pass with no dependency, lock, or workflow change and the generated-artifact guard green
one exact-head hosted validation passes with zero real provider calls and the re-fetched canonical PR body passes the evidence consistency guard before Ready YES
